wikidot5e:wondrous-items:deck-of-miscell.effectSummary: A 32-card deck whose cards may be deliberately chosen. As an action, draw one and throw it into an unoccupied space within 5 feet; it permanently becomes the depicted mundane item or set. Diamond cards: 3 wooden abacus; 4 four perfume vials; 5 five days of rations; 6 iron pot; 7 disguise kit; 8 a window up to 5 by 5 feet that can be placed on a vertical surface up to 5 feet thick and lets you see through it; 9 manacles; 10 ten parchment sheets. Hearts: 3 three daggers; 4 four oil flasks; 5 five silk robes; 6 forgery kit; 7 quarterstaff; 8 fishing tackle; 9 pouch with 18 gp; 10 ten crossbow bolts. Clubs: 3 three Common-language books about random historical events; 4 canvas tent; 5 fifty feet of silk rope; 6 two crowbars; 7 healer's kit; 8 eight 5-gp gems; 9 lamp; 10 ten feet of iron chain. Spades: 3 three spears; 4 steel mirror; 5 fifteen-foot wooden pole; 6 burlap sack; 7 two sets fine clothes; 8 shovel; 9 light hammer; 10 ten arrows.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:deck-of-oracles.effectSummary: After each long rest, spend 10 minutes consulting the deck, roll a d20, and record the result. Once during the next 8 hours, immediately after a creature within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, use your reaction to replace its d20 with the stored number. Separately, while holding the deck, cast divination once per dawn.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:deck-of-several.effectSummary: A 22-card adventure-specific variant using the same declare-and-draw timing as a Deck of Many Things: declare draws first, each must occur within 1 hour, excess draws have no effect, and unfinished declared draws fly out and resolve together. Cards normally fade and return to the deck except Fool and Jester. Mapping matches the standard 22-card deck: Ace♦ Vizier, K♦ Sun, Q♦ Moon, J♦ Star, 2♦ Comet; Ace♥ Fates, K♥ Throne, Q♥ Key, J♥ Knight, 2♥ Gem; Ace♣ Talons, K♣ Void, Q♣ Flames, J♣ Skull, 2♣ Idiot; Ace♠ Donjon, K♠ Ruin, Q♠ Euryale, J♠ Rogue, 2♠ Balance; trademark Joker Fool, other Joker Jester. Effects are tailored to the Lost Laboratory adventure: Balance reverses alignment axes. Comet grants one level's worth of XP if you solo the next hostile encounter. Donjon teleports you into the Monastery of the Distressed Body prison, leaves gear behind, and ends further draws. Euryale gives -1 saves for the adventure. Fates erases one event before death. Flames makes the monastery's Grand Master your enemy, or a similarly powerful devil patron if already defeated. Fool imposes DM-chosen lost proficiency or disadvantage with one skill for the adventure and forces another draw counting as the same declared draw. Gem creates the adventure's 1,000-gp leprechaun hoard or equivalent. Idiot lowers Intelligence by 1d4+1 to minimum 1 for the adventure and grants one extra draw. Jester grants one skill proficiency for the adventure or two extra draws. Key creates a common/uncommon proficient magic weapon or a spell scroll of a castable level for the adventure. Knight summons a currently absent NPC hireling who loyally serves you for the adventure. Moon grants 1d3 castings of any spell of 5th level or lower during the adventure. Rogue makes a DM-chosen NPC secretly hostile; a 6th-level-or-higher enchantment can end it. Ruin removes nonmagic wealth until recovered later from the monastery treasury or Kwalish's lab. Skull creates a mechanical avatar of death using bone naga statistics for a solo fight; helpers each summon their own, and avatar victims cannot be restored. Star raises one ability by 1, maximum 24, for the adventure. Sun grants a skill proficiency and a DM-chosen common/uncommon wondrous item for the adventure. Talons removes all carried/worn magic items until recoverable later in the adventure. Throne grants Persuasion proficiency and expertise for the adventure and recognition by the monastery's brains in jars as rightful master after clearing its hostile occupants. Vizier grants one truthful meditative answer plus guidance in applying it during the adventure. Void traps your soul in machinery in the monastery or Kwalish's lab, incapacitates your body, ends further draws, and divination, contact other plane, or similar 4th-level-or-higher magic reveals the prison's location.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:deck-of-wild-ca.effectSummary: The deck works only with random draws. As an action, draw and throw a random card as a Dexterity-based ranged spell attack with 30-foot range. On a hit it deals 1d4 slashing plus a suit effect, then returns to the deck whether hit or miss. Rods/clubs: target and creatures within 5 feet make DC 15 Dexterity or take 2d8 fire. Coins/diamonds: target makes DC 15 Dexterity; on failure it is blinded until the end of your next turn and every creature within 10 feet takes 1d6 lightning. Cups/hearts: target takes 1d10 cold and makes DC 15 Constitution or is restrained until the end of your next turn. Swords/spades: target and creatures within 5 feet take 1d6 force and make DC 15 Strength or fall prone.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:deck-of-wonder.effectSummary: A 13-card deck in most cases, or 22 cards in 25% of decks. Declare intended draws before drawing; excess draws have no effect, each declared draw must occur within 1 hour of the previous, and unfinished declared draws fly out and resolve simultaneously. Drawn cards normally fade and return to the deck; Mystery is the exception. Mapping: A♦ Chancellor, K♦ Day, Q♦ Night, J♦ Dawn, 2♦ Dusk; A♥ Destiny, K♥ Crown, Q♥ Lock, J♥ Champion, 2♥ Coin; A♣ Vulture, K♣ Chaos, Q♣ Order, J♣ Beginning, 2♣ Mystery; A♠ Isolation, K♠ End, Q♠ Monster, J♠ Knife, 2♠ Justice; trademark Joker Student, other Joker Mischief. Twenty-two-card-only cards are Chancellor, Dusk, Destiny, Coin, Vulture, Mystery, Isolation, Justice, Student. Beginning raises current and max HP by 2d10 for 8 hours. Champion gives +1 weapon attacks/damage for 8 hours. Chancellor allows one component-free augury as an action within 8 hours, using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Chaos grants DM-chosen acid/cold/fire/lightning/thunder resistance for 1d12 days. Coin creates five 100-gp jewelry pieces or ten 50-gp gems. Crown teaches friends using chosen Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, unless already known. Dawn adds proficiency bonus to initiative for 8 hours. Day grants +1 saves until a long rest. Destiny makes the first damaging effect that would reduce you to 0 HP reduce you to 1 instead. Dusk gives initiative disadvantage until long rest or remove curse/similar magic. End deals 2d10 necrotic and reduces max HP by the damage to minimum max 10 until long rest or curse removal. Isolation sends you and gear to a harmless extradimensional space for 1d4 minutes and ends further draws; when returned, DC 11 Constitution or poisoned 1 hour. Justice, for 8 hours, lets your reaction cancel advantage/disadvantage on a d20 roll by you or a creature within 60 feet. Knife creates a DM-chosen uncommon proficient magic weapon. Lock grants 1d3 knock castings using chosen Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Mischief creates a DM-chosen uncommon wondrous item or grants two extra draws. Monster curses saves with -1d4 until long rest or curse removal. Mystery gives disadvantage on Intelligence saves for 1 hour, is discarded, and forces another draw counting as the same declared draw. Night grants 300-foot darkvision for 8 hours. Order grants DM-chosen force/necrotic/poison/psychic/radiant resistance for 1d12 days. Student grants Wisdom-save proficiency, or Intelligence/Charisma-save proficiency if already proficient in Wisdom saves. Vulture makes one DM-chosen nonmagical possessed item disappear nearby; DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) finds it before it vanishes forever after 1 hour.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:defender.effectSummary: This magic sword grants +3 to attack and damage. The first time you attack with it on each turn, you may transfer any amount of that +3 to AC instead of using that amount on any of your sword attacks that turn. The chosen attack/damage and AC bonuses last until the start of your next turn; you must keep holding the sword to retain its AC bonus.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:dekella.effectSummary: Artifact +3 trident whose hits deal an extra 2d10 cold. A worshiper of Thassa gains: piety 10+ underwater breathing and 60-foot swim speed; 25+ one random minor beneficial property; 50+ one random major beneficial property. A non-worshiper instead has one random minor and one major detrimental property. Once per dusk, as an action, change sea conditions within 1 mile by creating violent winds/heavy rain/waves or calming a storm for 1 hour. Also once per dusk, cast dominate monster at save DC 18, but only targeting beasts or monstrosities with innate swim speeds. Separately once per dusk, cast true polymorph at save DC 18, only to transform a creature into a kind with an innate swim speed. Destroy by heating it with an ancient red dragon's breath and immersing it while hot in the Tartyx River.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:delvers-claws.effectSummary: The glove is a simple finesse light melee weapon dealing 1d4 slashing. While attuned, gain a burrowing speed equal to walking speed and 15-foot blindsight. Once per dawn, as an action invoke its rune and spend up to proficiency bonus unspent Hit Dice; roll them and regain HP equal to the total plus Constitution modifier.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:demon-armor.effectSummary: While wearing this +1 AC plate, you can speak and understand Abyssal. Its clawed gauntlets make your hand unarmed strikes magical slashing weapons with +1 attack and damage and a 1d8 damage die. Curse: after donning it, you cannot remove it until remove curse or similar magic targets you. While wearing it, you have disadvantage on attacks against demons and on saves against demon spells and special abilities.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:demon-skin.effectSummary: Attunement causes the black ichor to form heavy armor directly over your skin; it fits under normal clothing, does not impede bodily functions, and cannot be removed except by your choice or death, when it returns to its pot. While worn, gain poison resistance and the armor does not impose disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
